transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Card Member Services. My name is Julian. May I have your name, please?
Customer: Hi, yes, my name is Nikhil Varga.
Agent: Hello, Mr. Varga. Before we get started, could you please verify your billing zip code and the last four digits on your card?
Customer: Sure, the zip code is 48201, and the last four digits are 3109.
Agent: Thank you for confirming that. What can I help you with today?
Customer: Well, I was looking through my online account and saw a bunch of transactions from earlier this month that make no sense because I lost my card while I was traveling.
Agent: I see. When did you realize that the card was missing?
Customer: Right at the start of October. I took a weekend drive to visit family, and somewhere along the way, I think it slipped out of my jacket pocket.
Agent: And which specific transactions are you noticing that you did not make?
Customer: There are several charges dated October second. They are all from different stores in Tallow Creek.
Agent: Have you ever visited Tallow Creek, or been in that general area?
Customer: No, never. I was driving nowhere near there, and I had honestly never even heard of Tallow Creek until I saw those store locations.
Agent: Did you lend your card or share your card details with anyone else who might have been traveling there?
Customer: No, absolutely not. Nobody else has access to the card, and it was just me on the trip.
Agent: All right, Mr. Varga. Just to make sure I have all the facts down accurately, you lost physical possession of your card during a trip around early October, and then multiple charges appeared on October second from stores in Tallow Creek, which is a place you have never visited, and you did not share the card with anyone.
Customer: Yes, that is exactly right.
